purpose: Classify and recover from fleet setup/readiness failures without mislabeling them as agent, provider, tmux, or target-repository failures.

steps.name: preserve evidence
steps.action: Capture exact command, exit code, setup-summary/setup-transcript or startup-readiness artifact, and installed state observations before retrying.

classes.partial-install: exactly one of state or launcher exists; repair/reuse setup required
classes.adapter-blocked: fleet installed but requested adapter unavailable
classes.provider-verification: adapter available but authentication/model/quota/hosted response remains launch-time proof
classes.target-repo-dirty: target repository does not satisfy GNHF launch contract
classes.sprint-runtime: fleet and target gates passed; failure occurred after sprint launch

steps.name: repair owning boundary only
steps.action: Use repository-owned setup/readiness surfaces for bootstrap problems; provider tool flow for provider problems; target-repo preservation/isolation for dirty work; sprint evidence for runtime problems.

steps.name: avoid proof inflation
steps.action: Do not call a missing installed launcher an agent failure; do not call tmux attachment proof fleet installation proof; do not call adapter readiness hosted-response proof.

steps.name: rerun exact failed gate
steps.action: After repair, rerun only from a known safe state and preserve the first failed artifact as a separate attempt.

steps.name: handoff
steps.action: Report boundary, evidence path, repaired state, remaining unproved gate, and one exact next command.

proofCeiling: Failure classification and recovery routing only; success requires observed artifacts from the repaired owning boundary.
